_comment: Labelled inbox samples for ReplyClassifierTest. 'expect' is the status the
classifier must produce: invited | rejected | acknowledged | other | noise.
'noise' means triage should not even treat it as a candidate.
Recall on 'invited' is asserted at 1.00 — a missed invite fails the build.
Drawn from a real inbox, July 2026. ANONYMISED: company names, people and
email addresses are replaced with invented ones. The wording of each message
is verbatim, because the wording is the thing under test — as are the sender
shapes (ATS domains, noreply local-parts, personal addresses).
Private correspondence unrelated to job applications (legal, medical,
personal disputes) was deliberately left out rather than anonymised.
